summary: Visium Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the execution of a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire 100% of the equity of ConnexUS AI (DE) and secure a license to the RAGb x.co platform from owners/holders of WXYZ Hosting LLC and AdRetreaver LLC. The transaction uses a dual ring-fence structure for GAAP-compliant balance sheet isolation. Paul Taylor becomes Chairman and CEO as part of a strategic realignment. No price/share or premium terms were disclosed. The non-binding LOI leaves deal terms subject to negotiation; the absence of financial details and binding commitment raises execution risk. Watch for a definitive agreement or termination of the LOI.
